description: Commodity price now for gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper, crude oil (WTI and Brent), natural gas, gasoline, heating oil, corn, wheat, soybeans, coffee, sugar, cocoa or cotton: the front-month futures price with its unit, the day's change and percent, previous close, day range and 52-week range. XAU, oil and similar names work. Use to price a commodity in an agent, track inflation inputs, or add market context to a brief. Example: commodity=gold. Price $0.001/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
